review.finding: PUT /api/settings merges the raw request body into GlobalSettings with zero type/shape validation. A non-numeric codexStallTimeoutMinutes reaching settings.json would make Math.max(5, NaN) === NaN, and a NaN comparison in codex-task-watcher.ts's stall check is always false, so the oracle CLI would be invoked on every tick for every live Codex task rather than respecting the configured stall floor.
review.resolution: server/src/index.ts's stallTimeoutMs getter now coerces via Number(...) and falls back to the 15-minute default when the result is not finite (Number.isFinite guard), before applying the existing Math.max floor. tsc --noEmit clean; full server suite green (one unrelated pre-existing flake in pty-replay-attach-detach.test.ts, confirmed by re-running that file alone: 11/11 pass).

review.finding: buildCodexPrompt interpolates phase into a hand-built JSON-looking string without JSON-escaping. Not reachable today (phase is always catalog-validated before persisting) and not parsed by this codebase (prompt text shown to the Codex CLI) -- a latent correctness trap only, no injection risk.
review.resolution: Reviewer's own assessment: non-blocking, no reachable failure scenario today. Left as-is; worth revisiting only if this function ever receives a non-catalog-derived phase value.

review.finding: CodexNoticeCard duplicates ~110 lines of card-chrome JSX identical to the pre-existing pattern in InboxCard.AskTool.tsx / InboxCard.Waiting.tsx.
review.resolution: Reviewer's own assessment: not a new violation -- follows an established pre-existing convention faithfully (G5 justified duplication). Reviewer explicitly stated no action needed for this PR; a shared InboxCardChrome extraction is out of scope here.

Two low-severity correctness notes (one fixed in this round, one left as a documented non-reachable latent trap) and one architecture observation (no action needed, per the reviewer). Ready to ship as far as this quality pass is concerned.
